# @julianobazzi/nextjs-utils

> A collection of reusable hooks and utilities for Next.js (App Router and Pages
> Router), written in TypeScript. Built for Next.js, compatible with React 18 and 19.
> Client hooks ship with the `'use client'` directive applied at the bundle entry,
> so they can be imported directly into Server Components. Peer deps: react
> (^18 || ^19) and next (>=14, optional for root-entry-only use). Ships as ESM + CJS,
> each with its own TypeScript declarations.

Two entry points:
- Root `@julianobazzi/nextjs-utils` — core React hooks + utilities (never imports `next`).
- Subpath `@julianobazzi/nextjs-utils/next` — the Next.js router hooks.
Keeping `next` out of the root entry lets server-evaluated modules (e.g. `next build`
page-data collection) import core hooks without an `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`.
`import { useToggle } from '@julianobazzi/nextjs-utils'`
`import { useSearchParam } from '@julianobazzi/nextjs-utils/next'`

## Hooks (root entry)

- useToggle(initialValue = false): [value: boolean, toggle: () => void, set: (value?: boolean) => void]
  — Boolean state. `toggle()` flips it; `set(v)` assigns a value, `set()` flips.

- usePrevious<T>(value: T): T | undefined
  — Returns the value held on the previous render; `undefined` on first render.

- useDebounce<T>(value: T, delay = 500, options?: { onChange?: (value: T) => void }): T
- useDebounce<F extends (...args: any[]) => any>(fn: F, delay = 500, options?: { flushOnUnmount? }): DebouncedFunction<Parameters<F>>
  — Overloaded. Value form returns a debounced copy of `value`; `onChange` fires
    when the debounced value changes (never for the initial value). Function form
    returns a stable debounced callback with `.cancel()` and `.flush()`; the pending
    call is dropped on unmount, or run with `flushOnUnmount: true`.

- useThrottle<T>(value: T, delay = 500): T
- useThrottle<F extends (...args: any[]) => any>(fn: F, delay = 500, options?: { flushOnUnmount? }): ThrottledFunction<Parameters<F>>
  — Overloaded, mirrors useDebounce. Value form updates at most once per `delay` ms,
    settling on the latest value. Function form invokes on the leading edge, then
    collapses calls made during the wait into one trailing call with the latest
    args; exposes `.cancel()`/`.flush()`.

- useLocalStorage<T>(key: string, initialValue: T, options?: { serializer?, deserializer?, onError? }): [value: T, setValue: (v: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void, remove: () => void]
  — State persisted in localStorage (JSON by default), synced across components and
    tabs. Parsed values keep their identity until the stored string changes. Never
    throws: unavailable/full storage or bad data falls back to `initialValue` and
    reports through `onError`. SSR-safe.

- useCookie<T = string>(name: string, initialValue: T, options?: { days?, maxAge?, path?='/', domain?, sameSite?='lax', secure?: boolean | 'auto', serializer?, deserializer? }): [value, setValue, remove]
  — Like useLocalStorage, backed by document.cookie (JSON-serialized, URI-encoded).
    Synced across components in the same tab; changes from other tabs/the server are
    picked up via Cookie Store `change` events or on focus/visibility. Session cookie
    unless `days`/`maxAge` (seconds, wins) is set. `secure: 'auto'` = only on HTTPS.
    Use `deserializer: (raw) => raw` for plain-text cookies. SSR-safe; never HttpOnly.

- useMediaQuery(query: string, options?: { defaultValue?: boolean = false }): boolean
  — Reactively tracks a CSS media query via matchMedia + useSyncExternalStore.
    Returns `defaultValue` on the server, during hydration and without matchMedia.

- useEventListener(eventName, handler, target?, options?: boolean | { capture?, once?, passive?, enabled?=true }): void
  — Typed listener on window (default), document, an element, a ref, or any
    EventTarget, with cleanup. Handler kept in a ref. `enabled: false` detaches.
    An explicit `null` target falls back to window; a ref `{ current: null }` attaches nothing.

- useInterval(callback: () => void, delay: number | null): void
  — Runs `callback` every `delay` ms using the latest callback without resetting
    the timer. Pass `delay = null` to pause; clears on unmount.

- useOnlineStatus(): boolean
  — Tracks browser connectivity via online/offline events. `true` on the server.

- usePageVisibility(): boolean
  — Tracks document.visibilityState. `true` while visible; `true` on the server.

- useIdle(timeout = 60000): boolean
  — `true` after `timeout` ms without user activity (mouse, keyboard, wheel,
    scroll, touch). Resets to `false` on activity. `false` on the server.

- useBeforeUnload(enabled: boolean, message?: string): void
  — beforeunload confirmation while `enabled`. Client-side route changes do not fire it.

- useBroadcastChannel<T>(channelName: string, onMessage?: (data: T) => void, options?: { validate?: (data: unknown) => data is T, onError? }): { postMessage: (data: T) => void }
  — Cross-tab messaging via BroadcastChannel; closes on unmount. `validate` drops
    messages that fail the type guard. No-op on the server / without support.

- useHistoryState<T>(initialValue: T, options?: { capacity?=100 }): { state, set, undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo, clear, reset }
  — State with undo/redo. `set` (value or updater) pushes onto a bounded undo stack
    and clears redo; identical values record nothing. `clear()` drops history,
    keeping the state; `reset(value?)` drops history and sets the state
    (`initialValue` when omitted).

- useLatestRequest(): { start: () => { signal: AbortSignal; isCurrent: () => boolean }; cancel: () => void }
  — Keeps only the latest of overlapping async requests: `start()` aborts the
    previous one; check `isCurrent()` before setting state. Aborts on unmount.

- useDistinctTrigger<T>(options?: { isEqual? }): { shouldRun(value: T): boolean; remember(value?: T): void; reset(): void }
  — Run a lookup only for new values: `shouldRun` is false for the remembered
    value; `remember()` without args stores the last checked value.

- useInfiniteScroll({ onLoadMore, hasMore, enabled?=true, root?, rootMargin?='200px' }): { sentinelRef }
  — IntersectionObserver on a sentinel element; calls `onLoadMore` when visible.
    Pass `enabled: !isLoading`. No-op without IntersectionObserver.

- useRefreshKey(): [key: number, refresh: () => void]
  — Counter for a React `key`; `refresh()` remounts the subtree.

- useServiceWorkerUpdate(onUpdate: () => void): void
  — Calls `onUpdate` on service worker `controllerchange`, ignoring the first
    install on a page that had no controller. No-op without support.

- useReloadWhen(options?: { canReload?: () => boolean, retryMs?=1000, reload? }): { requestReload(): void }
  — Reloads (default: full page reload) as soon as `canReload()` allows; a request
    made while unsafe is retried every `retryMs`, not dropped.

- useDailyAt(hour: number, minute: number, callback: () => void): void
  — Runs `callback` every day at hour:minute local time; re-checks on
    visibilitychange so a run missed while asleep fires once.

- createCan<T>(useCurrentRoles: () => T | T[] | null | undefined): { useCan, Can }
  — Auth-agnostic role-based UI gating. `useCan(allowed?: T[]): boolean` and
    `Can({ allowed?, children, fallback? })`. Unauthenticated is denied; empty/omitted
    `allowed` grants any authenticated user; otherwise granted if any role is in
    `allowed`. UI only — enforce permissions on the server.

## Utilities (root entry)

- allowNumericBeforeInput(event: { data?, currentTarget, preventDefault }, options?: { allowDecimal?, allowNegative? }): boolean
  — beforeinput handler: prevents insertions whose resulting value is not numeric
    (one '.'/',' separator with allowDecimal, '-' only at the start with
    allowNegative). Covers virtual keyboards, paste and drop. Use type="text".

- allowNumericKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>, options?: { allowDecimal?, allowNegative? }): boolean
  — onKeyDown handler restricting typing to digits. Physical keyboards only
    (Android virtual keyboards, paste, autofill bypass it). Returns whether allowed.

## Next.js hooks (subpath /next)

URL write rules (useUpdateQueryParams and every hook built on it):
- Works in the App Router and the Pages Router (detected via next/compat/router).
  Pages Router: reads asPath, writes nothing before router.isReady.
- Shared options: history ('replace' | 'push', default 'replace'), scroll (false),
  shallow (false). `shallow: true` avoids the server round-trip: Pages Router
  shallow routing (no getServerSideProps), App Router History API (Next 14.1+).
- Calls in the same tick compose (e.g. toggleSort + setPage from different hooks).
- '', null, undefined, NaN/Infinity, invalid Date and [] delete a param; false and 0
  are written; Date -> ISO string; arrays -> repeated entries.
- In the App Router, hooks calling useSearchParams need <Suspense> on static routes.

- useSearchParam(key: string, defaultValue?: string): string | null
  — Reads one query param. With a defaultValue returns string.

- useSearchParamState<T = string | undefined>(key: string, options?: { parse?: (raw: string | null) => T, serialize?: (value: T) => string | null | undefined, history?, scroll?, shallow? }): [T, (value: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void]
  — useState backed by one URL param. Equal values are no-ops; keeps the #hash;
    functional updates see pending same-tick changes.

- useUpdateQueryParams<T>(options?: { ignoredParams?, history?, scroll?, shallow?, skipUnchanged?=false, preserveHash?=false }): (params?: Partial<T>) => void
  — Writes multiple params from an object. No argument clears all params (and the
    hash unless preserveHash). skipUnchanged skips navigations that change nothing.

- useUpdateSearchParam(options?: { key?='search', history?, scroll?, shallow?, trim?=false }): (value?: string) => void
  — One param. Empty value removes it; an unchanged value never navigates.

- useFilterQueryParams<T>({ parameters, deps, search?, setSearch?, initialSearch?: string | null, searchKey?='search', ignoredParams?, overrides?, resetKeys?, history?, scroll?, shallow?, preserveHash? }): { handleSearch(value?: string): void }
  — Syncs a filter form's state to the URL on [deps, search], skipping syncs that
    change nothing. The first sync waits for the initialSearch seed (one navigation
    on mount) and for Pages Router isReady. searchKey is only written when the hook
    manages a search. resetKeys are deleted when deps/search change after the first sync.

- usePaginationParams(options?: { pageKey?='page', pageSizeKey?='pageSize', defaultPageSize?=10, maxPageSize?, lastPage?, history?, scroll?, shallow? }): { page, pageSize, setPage, setPageSize, reset }
  — Pagination in the URL; defaults stay out of the URL; setPageSize resets to
    page 1; maxPageSize/lastPage clamp; invalid params fall back to defaults.

- useSortParams(options?: { sortKey?='sortBy', orderKey?='order', defaultSort?, defaultOrder?='asc', allowedSorts?, resetKeys?, history?, scroll?, shallow? }): { sortBy, order, toggleSort, clearSort }
  — Sorting in the URL. toggleSort cycles unsorted -> defaultOrder -> flipped ->
    unsorted (with defaultSort it falls back to that column). allowedSorts rejects
    other columns. resetKeys are deleted in the same navigation.

- useActiveRoute(href: string, options?: { exact? }): boolean
  — Whether the pathname matches href by whole segments; root '/' only exactly.

- useHashParam(defaultValue?: string): [value: string | undefined, setValue: (value?: string, options?: { history?: 'push' | 'replace' }) => void]
  — Reads/writes the '#hash' without a Next.js navigation. Setting pushes by default
    (location.hash); clearing replaces by default. SSR-safe.

- createRouteProgress(options?: { ignoreSamePathname?=true }): { onRouterTransitionStart, useRouteProgress(options?: { timeoutMs?=10000, doneMs?=300, ignoreShallow?=true }): 'idle' | 'loading' | 'done' }
  — Progress-bar state. App Router: export onRouterTransitionStart from
    instrumentation-client.ts (Next 15.3+); done when the URL commits. Pages Router:
    follows router.events by itself.

- useRouterEvent(event: 'routeChangeStart' | 'routeChangeComplete' | 'routeChangeError' | 'beforeHistoryChange' | 'hashChangeStart' | 'hashChangeComplete', handler: (url: string, info: { shallow: boolean; error?: unknown }) => void): void
  — Pages Router events with cleanup. No-op in the App Router.

- useStaleBuildReload(options?: { guardKey?, minIntervalMs?=10000 }): void
- isStaleBuildNavigationError(error: unknown): boolean
  — Reload when code from an outdated build fails to load (ChunkLoadError, failed
    dynamic imports; Pages Router routeChangeError goes to the target URL). A
    sessionStorage guard prevents reload loops. Use the predicate in error.tsx.

## Notes

- Peer deps: react (^18 || ^19), next (>=14, optional). The library never bundles them.
- Build: tsup. Lint/format: Biome. Tests: Vitest + Testing Library (jsdom), 100% coverage.
- Source layout: src/hooks/ (React hooks), src/utils/ (non-hook helpers), src/next/ (Next-specific).
- Pure, non-React helpers (query parsing, server-side cookies, role checks) belong
  in @julianobazzi/utils, not here.
- Source: https://github.com/julianobazzi/nextjs-utils
- Full docs: ./README.md (English) and ./README.pt-br.md (Portuguese).
